notes: Research (recall): Stephen Toulmin, The Uses of Argument (1958), a model of practical, field-dependent argument as opposed to the syllogism. Six parts: Claim (what is to be accepted), Grounds/Data (the specific facts appealed to), Warrant (the general, bridge-like inference licence 'if D then C', normally left unstated), Backing (the field-specific assurance behind the warrant: statutes, statistics, expertise), Qualifier (modal strength: presumably, probably, necessarily), Rebuttal (conditions of exception under which the warrant does not license the step). Textbook case: Harry was born in Bermuda, so presumably Harry is a British subject, since a person born in Bermuda is generally a British subject, on account of the relevant statutes, unless both parents were aliens or he has been naturalised elsewhere. Native diagram: grounds at left, arrow to 'so, qualifier, claim' at right, warrant under the arrow ('since'), backing under the warrant ('on account of'), rebuttal hanging off the qualifier ('unless'). Common misuse: warrant restated as a specific claim rather than a general rule; backing confused with grounds (backing supports the warrant, not the claim); rebuttal confused with a counter-claim (it is a condition, not an opposing argument); qualifier dropped so every claim sounds certain. Provenance expectation: grounds and claim are usually stated (fact); warrant is almost always unstated (derived); backing is stated only when the speaker is pressed; qualifier is sometimes stated as a hedge ('probably', 'I think'); rebuttal is occasionally stated ('unless') but mostly derived. No sibling framework is done yet, so house style comes from _meta/sample/graph.json only. Chose Hutchins: one speaker, one passage (L4720-4890), all six slots fillable with facts except the warrant, which is genuinely unstated and contestable; a rebuttal is stated by another guest (Byrne Hobart, L3300) in the same file and by the host right after (L4896-4900). Edge convention: rebuts targets the claim (registry description) rather than the qualifier as in Toulmin drawing; supported_by links carry each derived node to its facts. idea_bearing_slot = rebuttal: the derived exception conditions name the underserved needs (counterparty-risk rating/insurance for compute offtake; priced residual-value market for used accelerators).
